question: 如果减免燃油附加费，且票价半价，预计比当前便宜多少钱？

steps.description: Locate the original ticket price in the itinerary and extract the numerical value
Find the airport construction fee in the itinerary and extract the numerical value
Identify the fuel surcharge amount in the itinerary and extract the numerical value
Sum the ticket price, airport construction fee, and fuel surcharge to get the original total cost
Multiply the ticket price from step_1 by 0.5 to calculate the discounted ticket price
Add the discounted ticket price from step_5 and airport construction fee from step_2 to get the new total
Subtract the new total from step_6 from the original total from step_4 to find the savings
